hook: A twisting magnet radiates low frequencies up to 49,000 times more efficiently than a loop antenna.
summary: Small low-frequency antennas are inefficient because size limits radiation. This design twists a magnetic dipole with a piezoelectric resonator instead of driving a current, at 15.4 and 668 hertz, beating size-matched loop antennas by 49,000 and 5000 times in efficiency. It supported underwater communication over 115 meters on milliwatt power. Demonstrations were short range prototypes, not deployed networks.
title: Piezoelectrically actuated magnetic dipole twisting resonators enable miniaturized low-frequency antennas.
